candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show inventory reservation succeeding (200) while payment authorization fails with 503, propagating to order 502 and checkout 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side root cause (config, resource, dependency) not observable; only the 503 propagation is established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by downstream payment 503s: traces show inventory reservation succeeding while payment authorization fails, propagating to order and checkout 502. Metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. The proximate failing component is payment, but its internal cause is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics to determine why /v1/authorizations returns 503
Payment dependency health (DB/upstream) to distinguish config vs resource exhaustion
